name: harness
about: THE SELFTEST'S GROUND (sim/worlddefaults.h kHarnessMapName): --selftest, --verify, --suite, --vk-smoke, the fluid benches and --shot generate this map, never the game's. Its planes and terrain are a copy of `default` as it stood when the harness moved out of it (2026-09-26), so repainting the shipped map cannot move a gate; edit THIS map only to change a fixture's ground, and expect to rebaseline.

terrain.about: The terrain, per MAP: the seeded NOISE on the authored height plane (map v2). Lengths in voxels at refVoxelsPerMetre; log2 cells are shifts; fbmAtten / sedFraction / sedSlope / rockSlope are Q8 counts. The ground is planes.height (absolute voxels) + range/hill/detail/grain (the seeded octave ladder; the biome curve shapes the range rung); homeArea is the calm noise around the spawn site (radius, fade). The sediment wedge fills where the noise sits below the AUTHORED ground + sedAbove (relative, map v2 A1). treeline is the map's ground Y of the treeline: a column's own is sea + (treeline - sea) x its biome's treelineScale, +- treelineJitter. rockSlope: columns at least this steep skin as rock (0 = off). baseHeight is the height used only when no plane is loaded. Per-biome relief is each biome file's `terrain` block.

sites.about: The calm pad box over the fixture ground: no tree trunks or crowns, no tarns, no cover, coarse octaves faded toward its edge. Keeps every fixture column (60..150 on the x==z diagonal) on the ground the gates were written against.

The fixture lake (sim/worlddefaults.h kHarnessLakeSite): the waterbody/current gates' basin, --fluid-bench worldlake and the water --shot scenes. Was a literal disc in worldgen.wgsl and four copies in world.cpp until 2026-09-26.
Where the game starts, and the centre of the calm home area (terrain.homeArea). Must be on land, off the harness pad and off any lake: the spawn-site gate checks all of that.
An AUTHORED lake (P-F): same place on every seed, the spawn_lake preset's geometry. Placed on the map, not relative to the spawn; the spawn-site gate checks the spawn stays off it.

dungeons.name: Engine fixture dungeon
dungeons.about: The dungeon-format / dungeon-gen gates' fixture (docs/PLAN_dungeons.md D1): assets/dungeons/_fixture, turned a quarter so the local frame is exercised. On flat-ish land 2 km east of the pad (ground 149..204 over its footprint, the anchor near the low end, so every room is under the ground) and 3.8 km from the spawn: no other gate's ground moves.
